academic_translation:
This Dharma of the Guides is profound and difficult to see;
It is not realized by anyone, nor is there any attaining of it.
Therefore, the Compassionate Benefactor, having attained awakening,
Felt little inclination, thinking, "Who among the masses of sentient beings will understand?"
translation: This teaching of the Guides is deep and hard to see. No one has realized it, and no one has reached it. So, when the Kind Helper reached awakening, he paused. He thought, "Who among all the living beings will understand this?"
